section.title: org.osgi.service.repository
section.para: Repository Service Package Version 1.1.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.repository; version="[1.1,2.0)"}
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:
{@code Import-Package: org.osgi.service.repository; version="[1.1,1.2)"}

listitem.para: AndExpression - A {@link RequirementExpression} representing the {@code and} of a number of requirement expressions.
ContentNamespace - Content Capability and Requirement Namespace.

ExpressionCombiner - An {@code ExpressionCombiner} can be used to combine requirement expressions into a single complex requirement expression using the {@code and}, {@code or} and {@code not} operators.
IdentityExpression - A {@link RequirementExpression} representing a requirement.
NotExpression - A {@link RequirementExpression} representing the {@code not} (negation) of a requirement expression.
OrExpression - A {@link RequirementExpression} representing the {@code or} of a number of requirement expressions.
Repository - A repository service that contains {@link Resource resources}.
RepositoryContent - An accessor for the content of a resource.
RequirementExpression - The super interface for all requirement expressions.

section.title: public final class ContentNamespace extends Namespace
section.para: Content Capability and Requirement Namespace.

This class defines the names for the attributes and directives for this namespace. All unspecified capability attributes are of type {@code String} and are used as arbitrary matching attributes for the capability. The values associated with the specified directive and attribute keys are of type {@code String}, unless otherwise indicated.

formalpara.title: Concurrency
formalpara.para: Immutable

section.title: public static final String CAPABILITY_MIME_ATTRIBUTE = "mime"
section.para: The capability attribute that defines the IANA MIME Type/Format for this content.

section.title: public static final String CAPABILITY_SIZE_ATTRIBUTE = "size"
section.para: The capability attribute that contains the size, in bytes, of the content. The value of this attribute must be of type {@code Long}.

section.title: public static final String CAPABILITY_URL_ATTRIBUTE = "url"
section.para: The capability attribute that contains the URL to the content.

section.title: public static final String CONTENT_NAMESPACE = "osgi.content"
section.para: Namespace name for content capabilities and requirements.
Also, the capability attribute used to specify the unique identifier of the content. This identifier is the {@code SHA-256} hash of the content.

section.title: public abstract Repository
section.para: A repository service that contains {@link Resource resources}.
Repositories may be registered as services and may be used as by a resolve context during resolver operations.
Repositories registered as services may be filtered using standard service properties.

formalpara.title: Concurrency
formalpara.para: Thread-safe

formalpara.title: Provider Type
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this type

section.title: public static final String URL = "repository.url"
section.para: Service property to provide URLs related to this repository.
The value of this property must be of type {@code String}, {@code String[]}, or {@code Collection<String>}.

section.title: public abstract Map<Requirement, Collection<Capability>> findProviders(Collection<? extends Requirement> requirements)

formalpara.title: requirements
formalpara.para: The requirements for which matching capabilities should be returned. Must not be {@code null}.

section.para: Find the capabilities that match the specified requirements.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A map of matching capabilities for the specified requirements. Each specified requirement must appear as a key in the map. If there are no matching capabilities for a specified requirement, then the value in the map for the specified requirement must be an empty collection. The returned map is the property of the caller and can be modified by the caller. The returned map may be lazily populated, so calling {@code size()} may result in a long running operation.

section.title: public abstract Promise<Collection<Resource>> findProviders(RequirementExpression expression)

formalpara.title: expression
formalpara.para: The {@code RequirementExpression} for which matching capabilities should be returned. Must not be {@code null}.

section.para: Find the resources that match the specified requirement expression.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A promise to a collection of matching {@code Resource}s. If there are no matching resources, an empty collection is returned. The returned collection is the property of the caller and can be modified by the caller. The returned collection may be lazily populated, so calling {@code size()} may result in a long running operation.

formalpara.title: Since
formalpara.para: @since 1.1

section.title: public abstract RepositoryContent
section.para:
An accessor for the content of a resource.
All {@link Resource} objects which represent resources in a {@link Repository} must implement this interface. A user of the resource can then cast the {@link Resource} object to this type and then obtain an {@code InputStream} to the content of the resource.

formalpara.title: Concurrency
formalpara.para: Thread-safe

formalpara.title: Provider Type
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this type

section.title: public abstract InputStream getContent()
section.para: Returns a new input stream to the content of this resource. The content is represented on the resource through the {@code osgi.content} capability. If more than one such capability is associated with the resource, the first such capability is returned.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A new input stream for associated content.
